summary:
UI Freeze & Performance Optimization QA Plan:
- Fix O(N^2) unmatched row diagnosis in excel.ts by adding pre-computed indexed lookups.
- Offload LZString compression/decompression to a non-blocking Web Worker and eliminate duplicate JSON.stringify calls in supabaseSync.ts.
- Optimize ResultsDashboard with useDeferredValue, search blobs, deduplicated useEffect hooks, and memoized column filter value computations.
